blocks.text: A flash flood in the Budhi Gandaki river early Sunday has caused widespread damage in Chumnubri and Dharche rural municipalities in Gorkha district. The flood has swept away houses, bridges and infrastructure at a hydropower project, while inundating settlements and putting more homes at risk. Authorities are still assessing the damage and investigating the cause.
